name: log-movie-time
description: Structured log, timing probe of the movie path: event mv_frame (CPU 0), one record per run of mov_image_process for recording 0x7E6C6E46 (one movie frame): the microseconds from its entry to its end, the microseconds of its develop job (img_exec, Bayer to YC) and its return value; event mv_enc (CPU 1), one record per packet of the task MOV_ENCODE: the microseconds in its handler and the microseconds that the task ART_SUB spent since the last record. Five hooks in stock bytes of segment 1, their routines in segment 1, 32 bytes of RAM at 0x7E4FD300. Needs the specs of data/builds/epm2mod-2026.11.19.json before it: every expect is a byte string of that build. It puts the build id 34775ddcf8f5f0af of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-19-movie-sampling/NOTES.md and docs/reference/logging.md.
_ram: 32 bytes at 0x7E4FD300 (uncached alias 0xBE4FD300), after the log's block buffer; not cleared at start

ops._note: new code, segment 1 (free part of lss-core's area): T_MVS, T_MVE, T_DEV, T_ART, T_ENCA, T_ENCB (416 B)
hook (mv_frame): jmp T_MVS. mov_image_process (record) 0x7E6C6E46, entry: `add -512,sp` / `clr d2` (MOV_TASK)
hook (mv_frame): jmp T_MVE. mov_image_process (record), end: `exthu d0` / `add 512,sp` before `ret`
hook (mv_frame): jmp T_DEV + nop + nop. 0x7E6C7225 (built from 0x7E6C8841): the develop job, `call 0x7E6DABAF` (mov img_exec)
hook (mv_enc): jmp T_ART + nop. ART_SUB task loop (CPU 1): `mov a2,a0` / `call 0x7E72CD3E`, the handler of a message
hook (mv_enc): jmp T_ENCA + nop. MOV_ENCODE task loop (CPU 1): `mov a2,a0` / `call 0x7E6D5641` (packet command 256)
hook (mv_enc): jmp T_ENCB + nop. MOV_ENCODE task loop (CPU 1): `mov a2,a0` / `call 0x7E6D564D` (other commands)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 33ca8d15 -> 34775ddc (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 f4f1c877 -> f8f5f0af (data/logdict/events.json)
